name: Basket
overview: The Bible presents baskets as vessels of provision and sacred offerings, as seen when Aaron and his sons carry baskets of unleavened bread during their consecration (Exodus 29:3, 23, 32; Leviticus 8:2). Baskets also appear in personal and symbolic contexts, such as the chief baker's dream involving baskets on his head (Genesis 40:16-17). These passages highlight the basket's role in both practical service and divine communication within God's redemptive plan.
